# LazyMatrix

> LazyMatrix provides Rust and Python interfaces for centering and scaling matrices without materializing them.

The website contains the user guide, benchmark comparisons, and Python and Rust
API references. The Rust API is also hosted on docs.rs. LazyMatrix is in early development, and breaking
changes are expected.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://lazymatrix.org/guide/getting-started): Installation, backend selection, and eager conversion.
- [How it works](https://lazymatrix.org/guide/how-it-works): Normalization identities and sparse storage behavior.
- [Python guide](https://lazymatrix.org/guide/python): NumPy and SciPy usage, ownership, and supported operations.
- [Python API reference](https://lazymatrix.org/reference/python/): Public classes and methods.
- [Rust API reference](https://lazymatrix.org/reference/rust/): Public types, traits, and methods.
- [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/lazymatrix): The Rust API reference hosted by docs.rs.
- [Benchmarks](https://lazymatrix.org/benchmarks): Construction, repeated operations, and memory costs.
- [Source code](https://github.com/jolars/lazymatrix): Implementation, examples, and releases.
